hypothesis: After a scheduled regular FOMC statement, the observed XAUUSD price reaction contains either short-lived underreaction or overreaction that remains capturable intraday after current Ostium costs.
falsifier: Reject before StrategyQuant unless a connected train region survives conservative event execution, stress costs, year stability and 200-USDC risk sizing.
independence: New external-event mechanism. No thresholds, performance results or candidate artifacts from prior XAU price-only grids are reused; only audited data-loading and accounting patterns may be technical references.
external_evidence: Federal Reserve official FOMC calendars and statement pages
Gurkaynak, Sack and Swanson (2005), International Journal of Central Banking, Do Actions Speak Louder Than Words?
event: scheduled regular FOMC statement at 14:00 America/New_York

execution.signal: direction of XAUUSD open-to-open move from 14:00 ET through the frozen reaction window
execution.entry: M15 open immediately after the 15/30-minute reaction window
execution.exit: protective stop or M15 open after 60/120 minutes
execution.intrabar_policy: gap liquidation check, then gap stop, then stop before time exit

sq_if_pass.fixed_mechanism: immutable FOMC calendar plus observed post-statement reaction direction
